key_insight: FinAutoRubric uses expert-guided agents plus code-enforced rules to automatically generate finance evaluation rubrics that preserve institutional standards and fixed-cutoff correctness.
engineering_relevance: It offers a scalable way to create query-specific, expert-aligned benchmarks for financial research agents without hand-writing every rubric item.
method: Experts provide reusable guidance that is enforced as prompts and code rules across all agents.
A writer agent researches expected values and a reviewer agent verifies them in long-horizon loops.
A Task Bank reuses criteria across tasks, with failures escalating to humans when validation breaks.
evidence_signal: Across three expert-authored finance benchmarks, the generated rubrics closely matched expert scoring, agreed with human grading, and were preferred by in-house analysts in blind review; the released 100-query benchmark spans 78 tasks and eight asset classes.
watch_item: Because the system depends on long-horizon agent loops and expert guidance, errors in retrieved facts, reviewer checks, or guidance design can still propagate into the final rubric.
paper_title: FinAutoRubric: Expert-Guided Automatic Rubric Generation for Evaluating Financial Research Agents
